title: Fleet Management
description: ASP.NET Core MVC app to manage drivers, vehicles, and maintenance records. Role-based access (Admin/User), SQL Server with EF Core migrations, stored procedures, delete-audit triggers, and PDF exports with optional email delivery.

title: LocalApp
description: Privacy-first Expo mobile app that tracks your day in the background: GPS routes, visit duration, and walking vs driving detection. Data stays on-device in SQLite (no server). Includes timeline, map with routes, daily summaries, and dashboard charts. Resumes tracking after reboot via background location tasks.
